name: Puppy
Special Ability: **Loyal Companion** - Boosts player morale and provides advantage on Charisma checks while active.
Happiness Effect: +15 happiness daily when petted
Description: A small, fluffy golden retriever puppy with bright eyes and a wagging tail. It follows you everywhere with boundless enthusiasm.

name: Kitten
Special Ability: **Silent Prowl** - Increases stealth by 10% when exploring dungeons.
Happiness Effect: +12 happiness daily, purrs when held
Description: A sleek black kitten with piercing green eyes and a curious disposition. It silently stalks imaginary prey around your feet.

name: Bunny
Special Ability: **Lucky Hare** - Small chance to avoid enemy attacks entirely.
Happiness Effect: +10 happiness daily, especially when given carrots
Description: A fluffy white bunny with pink-tipped ears and a cotton-ball tail. It hops energetically and loves to be stroked.

name: Sparrow
Special Ability: **Keen Eyes** - Reveals hidden items in a 20-foot radius.
Happiness Effect: +8 happiness daily, sings in the morning
Description: A small brown sparrow with clever eyes that chirps cheerfully. It perches on your shoulder and scans the surroundings.

name: Fox Kit
Special Ability: **Sly Dodge** - 15% chance to evade critical hits.
Happiness Effect: +14 happiness daily, plays tricks on companions
Description: A rust-colored fox kit with a white-tipped tail and mischievous glint in its eyes. It pounces on leaves and chases its own tail.

name: Deer Fawn
Special Ability: **Forest Grace** - Improves navigation speed in wooded areas by 20%.
Happiness Effect: +13 happiness daily, calm presence reduces stress
Description: A spotted fawn with delicate legs and large, trusting eyes. It moves with ethereal grace through the underbrush.

name: Hedgehog
Special Ability: **Spiny Shield** - Reflects 10% of melee damage back to attackers.
Happiness Effect: +9 happiness daily, curls into a ball when scared
Description: A small, round hedgehog covered in sharp quills. It waddles about searching for beetles and occasionally rolls into a protective ball.

name: Owl
Special Ability: **Night Vision** - Grants perfect vision in darkness and boosts perception at night.
Happiness Effect: +11 happiness daily, hoots softly at dusk
Description: A great horned owl with amber eyes and mottled brown feathers. It swivels its head to observe threats you might miss.

name: Falcon
Special Ability: **Diving Strike** - First attack in combat deals double damage.
Happiness Effect: +16 happiness daily when fed fresh meat
Description: A peregrine falcon with slate-grey wings and a hooked beak. It circles high above, ready to swoop down on unsuspecting enemies.

name: Wolf Pup
Special Ability: **Pack Tactics** - Increases damage by 10% when fighting alongside allies.
Happiness Effect: +17 happiness daily, howls at the moon with you
Description: A grey wolf pup with golden eyes and oversized paws. It has a wild spirit but remains fiercely loyal to its chosen companion.

name: Raccoon
Special Ability: **Lockpick Fingers** - Can attempt to open locked chests and doors automatically.
Happiness Effect: +12 happiness daily, loves to forage for trinkets
Description: A masked raccoon with dexterous little hands and curious eyes. It investigates every container and pocket it can find.

name: Squirrel
Special Ability: **Nut Cache** - Small chance to find extra supplies after battles.
Happiness Effect: +7 happiness daily, chitters excitedly
Description: A bushy-tailed squirrel with bright eyes and nimble paws. It hoards acorns and shiny objects with single-minded dedication.

name: Bat
Special Ability: **Echolocation** - Reveals hidden passages and secret rooms in caves.
Happiness Effect: +6 happiness daily, roosts upside down near you
Description: A small fruit bat with leathery wings and oversized ears. It hangs from your pack during the day and takes flight when darkness falls.

name: Snake
Special Ability: **Venomous Bite** - Attacks have a 10% chance to poison enemies for 3 turns.
Happiness Effect: +8 happiness daily when handled gently
Description: A sleek emerald snake with mesmerizing patterns. It coils around your arm and flicks its forked tongue, sensing nearby threats.

name: Bear Cub
Special Ability: **Mighty Hug** - Can grapple and stun enemies for one turn.
Happiness Effect: +18 happiness daily, loves to play-wrestle
Description: A fluffy brown bear cub with powerful paws and a playful growl. Despite its youth, it carries surprising strength and a protective nature.

name: Fairy
Special Ability: **Sparkle Dust** - Heals player for 5 HP per turn for 3 turns when activated.
Happiness Effect: +20 happiness daily, sprinkles glitter on everything
Description: A tiny luminous fairy with iridescent wings and a trail of sparkling dust. She giggles mischievously and grants small blessings.

name: Phoenix Chick
Special Ability: **Rebirth Flame** - Once per day, fully restores HP when reduced to zero.
Happiness Effect: +25 happiness daily, warms you with gentle flames
Found Location: Volcanic craters and sacred fire temples
Description: A miniature phoenix with brilliant orange and gold plumage. Wisps of flame dance along its feathers and its eyes glow like embers.

name: Sprite
Special Ability: **Minor Cantrip** - Casts a random beneficial cantrip each dawn (light, warmth, or cleaning).
Happiness Effect: +14 happiness daily, tells jokes and riddles
Description: A translucent blue sprite the size of your thumb. It zips through the air leaving a faint trail of light and speaks in a squeaky voice.

name: Will-o-Wisp
Special Ability: **Ghostlight** - Dazzles enemies, causing them to miss their next attack.
Happiness Effect: +10 happiness daily, dances playfully in the dark
Description: A floating orb of pale blue-green light that shifts and pulses. It leads you through treacherous terrain and confuses hostile creatures.

name: Magical Owl
Special Ability: **Arcane Sight** - Detects magical auras and invisible creatures within 30 feet.
Happiness Effect: +15 happiness daily, delivers cryptic wisdom
Description: An owl with feathers that shimmer like starlight and eyes that glow with inner knowledge. It speaks in riddles and understands all languages.

name: Imp
Special Ability: **Mischief** - Can steal one item from enemies once per battle.
Happiness Effect: +11 happiness daily, plays pranks on party members
Description: A small red-skinned imp with bat-like wings and a wicked grin. It cackles constantly and has sticky fingers.

name: Crystal Golem
Special Ability: **Prismatic Shield** - Absorbs elemental damage and converts it to healing.
Happiness Effect: +18 happiness daily, hums a resonant frequency
Description: A small humanoid figure made entirely of faceted crystal. It refracts light into rainbows and thrums with arcane energy.

name: Shadow Cat
Special Ability: **Shadow Meld** - Grants invisibility for 2 turns when health drops below 30%.
Happiness Effect: +16 happiness daily, purrs with an echoing quality
Description: A cat made of living shadow with glowing violet eyes. It phases between the material and ethereal planes at will.

name: Wisp
Special Ability: **Illuminate** - Lights up dark areas and reveals hidden traps.
Happiness Effect: +9 happiness daily, bobs cheerfully near your head
Description: A small floating orb of warm golden light. It hums softly and instinctively brightens when danger approaches.

name: Bookwyrm
Special Ability: **Lore Keeper** - Increases XP gain by 15% and reveals lore entries automatically.
Happiness Effect: +22 happiness daily, reads stories aloud before bed
Description: A tiny dragon made of parchment and ink with spectacles perched on its snout. It breathes small puffs of fragrant book-musk.

name: Zombie Cat
Special Ability: **Undying Pounce** - Attacks from beyond the grave; ignores armor on first strike.
Happiness Effect: +8 happiness daily, brings you "gifts" of bones
Description: A reanimated cat with patchy fur and glowing green eyes. It moves with an eerie, jerky gait but still purrs when scratched.

name: Skeleton Dog
Special Ability: **Bone Crunch** - Attacks deal bonus damage to constructs and other undead.
Happiness Effect: +10 happiness daily, wags its bony tail excitedly
Description: A complete canine skeleton that clatters when it walks. Its eye sockets glow with pale blue fire and it remains fiercely obedient.

name: Ghost Fox
Special Ability: **Phase Through** - Can pass through solid walls to scout ahead.
Happiness Effect: +14 happiness daily, curls up as a warm phantom presence
Found Location: Haunted forests and spirit realm borders
Description: A translucent fox made of silvery mist. It leaves no footprints and its tail trails wisps of ethereal vapor.

name: Lich Chick
Special Ability: **Soul Siphon** - Drains 5 HP from enemies and heals player on each hit.
Happiness Effect: +15 happiness daily, lectures you on necromantic theory
Description: A skeletal baby chicken wearing a tiny crown of dark iron. It glows with necrotic energy and speaks in a surprisingly deep voice.

name: Specter Rat
Special Ability: **Plague Touch** - Attacks have a chance to inflict a weakening disease on enemies.
Happiness Effect: +5 happiness daily, scurries around your feet
Description: A ghostly rat with hollow eyes and a trailing tail of smoke. It slips through keyholes and under doors with ease.

name: Bone Serpent
Special Ability: **Constrict** - Can immobilize enemies for 2 turns.
Happiness Effect: +9 happiness daily, coils around your arm like a living bracelet
Description: A snake skeleton that moves with fluid, lifelike grace. Its vertebrae click softly and its hollow skull houses a malevolent intelligence.

name: Revenant Owl
Special Ability: **Death Gaze** - Stares down enemies, reducing their attack power by 25% for 3 turns.
Happiness Effect: +11 happiness daily, watches over you while you sleep
Description: A spectral owl with hollow, weeping eye sockets and tattered ghostly feathers. Its hoot echoes across the veil between life and death.

name: Ghoul Pup
Special Ability: **Terrifying Howl** - Frightens all enemies, reducing their accuracy for 2 turns.
Happiness Effect: +7 happiness daily, though its "kisses" are a bit gross
Description: A reanimated puppy with ashen fur and red-rimmed eyes. It retains its playful puppy personality despite its undead condition.

name: Crypt Beetle
Special Ability: **Shell Wall** - Can block incoming damage for adjacent allies once per battle.
Happiness Effect: +6 happiness daily, chirps a haunting melody
Description: An iridescent black beetle with a carapace that glows faintly with death energy. It is surprisingly loyal and protective.

name: Clockwork Mouse
Special Ability: **Winding Key** - Self-repairs 5 HP each turn if not attacked.
Happiness Effect: +10 happiness daily, squeaks mechanically when happy
Description: A tiny brass mouse with gears visible through its glass belly. It scurries about on clockwork legs and winds itself with a key on its back.

name: Iron Hawk
Special Ability: **Metal Talons** - Attacks ignore enemy armor completely.
Happiness Effect: +13 happiness daily, perches stoically on your arm
Description: A mechanical hawk made of polished steel with ruby eyes. It flies with perfect precision and its feathers are razor-sharp blades.

name: Stone Guardian
Special Ability: **Fortify** - Creates a stone shield that absorbs 20 damage for the party.
Happiness Effect: +12 happiness daily, stoically stands guard while you rest
Description: A miniature stone golem with carved runes that pulse with protective magic. It moves slowly but is nearly indestructible.

name: Cog Spider
Special Ability: **Web of Gears** - Can slow enemies by tangling them in mechanical webs.
Happiness Effect: +8 happiness daily, builds tiny gear sculptures
Description: A spider made of interlocking gears and copper wires. It scuttles sideways and spins metallic silk that hums with energy.

name: Steam Beetle
Special Ability: **Steam Burst** - Emits a cloud of scalding steam, damaging adjacent enemies.
Happiness Effect: +7 happiness daily, hisses contentedly when warmed
Description: A bronze beetle with a tiny boiler on its back. It releases jets of steam when excited and stays warm on cold nights.

name: Tin Soldier
Special Ability: **Marching Order** - Boosts party defense by 10% when fighting in formation.
Happiness Effect: +9 happiness daily, stands at attention and salutes
Description: A tin soldier about 12 inches tall with a painted uniform and a tiny tin rifle. It marches with perfect discipline and never breaks formation.

name: Rune Doll
Special Ability: **Spell Storing** - Can absorb one spell and redirect it back at the caster.
Happiness Effect: +14 happiness daily, mimics your movements comically
Description: A cloth doll covered in glowing arcane runes. It animates with a mind of its own and has a surprisingly expressive face stitched from thread.

name: Pixie
Special Ability: **Fey Glamour** - Illusions confuse enemies, causing them to attack each other.
Happiness Effect: +18 happiness daily, braids flowers into your hair
Description: A tiny winged humanoid with butterfly wings and a crown of wildflowers. It speaks in rhyme and grants wishes that always come with a twist.

name: Dryad Sprout
Special Ability: **Entangle** - Roots sprout from the ground, immobilizing enemies for 2 turns.
Happiness Effect: +13 happiness daily, makes flowers bloom wherever it goes
Description: A tiny tree spirit with bark-like skin and leaves for hair. It is deeply connected to nature and weeps when surrounded by destruction.

name: Satyr Lamb
Special Ability: **Enchanting Bleat** - Its call boosts party morale, increasing all stats by 5% for 3 turns.
Happiness Effect: +11 happiness daily, dances playfully around campfires
Description: A small lamb with tiny curved horns and cloven hooves. It has an infectious joy and a surprisingly melodic voice.

name: Blink Fox
Special Ability: **Fey Step** - Teleports short distances to dodge attacks or reposition.
Happiness Effect: +15 happiness daily, plays endless games of hide-and-seek
Description: A fox that shimmers between dimensions, occasionally flickering out of existence. Its fur shifts colors like an oil slick and it leaves no tracks.

name: Mushroom Sprite
Special Ability: **Spore Cloud** - Releases calming spores that put weak enemies to sleep.
Happiness Effect: +10 happiness daily, grows tiny mushrooms around camp
Description: A small fairy-like creature with a mushroom cap for a hat and spore-dusted wings. It smells of earth and rain and giggles at inappropriate times.

name: Nymph
Special Ability: **Nature's Wrath** - Summons vines and thorns to damage and entangle all enemies.
Happiness Effect: +22 happiness daily, fills the air with sweet fragrance
Description: An ethereal being of breathtaking beauty with flowing hair like a waterfall and eyes like deep pools. Nature bends to her will.

name: Dragon Hatchling
Special Ability: **Elemental Breath** - Breathes a small cone of fire dealing damage to all enemies.
Happiness Effect: +19 happiness daily, nuzzles you with its warm snout
Description: A baby dragon with iridescent scales and tiny wing buds. It chirps like a bird and sneezes small flames when excited.

name: Sea Serpent
Special Ability: **Tidal Wave** - Summons a wave that damages and pushes back all enemies.
Happiness Effect: +16 happiness daily, splashes playfully in any water
Description: A sinuous sea dragon with fins like sails and scales that shimmer like abalone. It breathes bubbles and communicates through water patterns.

name: Frost Wyrm
Special Ability: **Blizzard Breath** - Freezes enemies in place for 2 turns and deals ice damage.
Happiness Effect: +17 happiness daily, keeps your drinks cold in summer
Description: A small white dragon with crystalline scales and breath that forms ice crystals. Its eyes are the pale blue of glacial ice.

name: Shadow Drake
Special Ability: **Void Breath** - Drains life force from enemies, healing the player.
Happiness Effect: +14 happiness daily, curls around you protectively at night
Description: A dragon made of living darkness with eyes like violet stars. It exists partially in another dimension and leaves trails of shadow.

name: Ember Whelp
Special Ability: **Heat Aura** - Warms allies and deals fire damage to enemies who attack in melee range.
Happiness Effect: +15 happiness daily, snuggles close for warmth on cold nights
Description: A small dragon with smoldering red scales and a belly that glows like coals. Smoke curls from its nostrils and its presence heats the surrounding air.

name: Thunder Drake
Special Ability: **Lightning Strike** - Calls down a bolt of lightning dealing massive damage to a single target.
Happiness Effect: +13 happiness daily, crackles with static electricity
Description: A sleek dragon with storm-grey scales and golden eyes that flash like lightning. Its wings generate thunderclaps when it takes flight.

name: Treasure Slime
Special Ability: **Gold Hoard** - Increases gold drops from battles by 25%.
Happiness Effect: +8 happiness daily, jiggles and sparkles
Description: A golden slime that oozes coins and gems. It bounces happily and leaves a trail of glitter wherever it goes.

name: Mimic Pup
Special Ability: **Chest Bite** - Can transform into a treasure chest to ambush enemies.
Happiness Effect: +12 happiness daily, pretends to be a box and jumps out to surprise you
Description: A small, dog-like mimic that looks like a miniature treasure chest with teeth. It wags its "lid" when happy and licks you with a sticky tongue.

name: Dice Golem
Special Ability: **Lucky Roll** - Random chance to deal anywhere from 1 to 20 extra damage.
Happiness Effect: +10 happiness daily, rolls around excitedly
Description: A small golem made of various polyhedral dice. Each limb is a different die and its face is a blank d20.

name: Cosmic Cat
Special Ability: **Starfall** - Calls down a shower of meteors dealing damage to all enemies.
Happiness Effect: +25 happiness daily, purrs with the sound of distant galaxies
Description: A cat made of the night sky itself, with constellations shifting across its fur. Its eyes are twin nebulae and it moves between stars.

name: Time Turtle
Special Ability: **Temporal Stasis** - Freezes time for enemies for one turn, allowing free actions.
Happiness Effect: +20 happiness daily, moves at its own pace and never worries
Description: A tortoise with a shell that shows swirling galaxies and shifting timelines. It has existed since the beginning of time and speaks in proverbs.

name: Paper Crane
Special Ability: **Origami Shield** - Folds itself into a paper shield, blocking one attack entirely.
Happiness Effect: +7 happiness daily, flutters gracefully through the air
Description: An origami crane made of enchanted paper that has come to life. It folds and unfolds itself into different shapes and dances on the wind.

name: Coin Elemental
Special Ability: **Lucky Penny** - Grants a small chance to completely avoid all damage once per battle.
Happiness Effect: +9 happiness daily, jingles musicaly when it walks
Description: A small elemental made entirely of gold coins that constantly shift and flow. It has a coin for a face and tiny coin hands.
